title: From judo mat to the stands: Ralph De Leon shows support for Ateneo
summary: Former "Pinoy Big Brother: Celebrity Collab Edition" housemate Ralph De Leon took some time off his busy schedule to show support for his alma mater in the UAAP Season 89 men's basketball tournament.
